services.desc: We pick up you and your group early in the afternoon for a unique evening experience visiting this renowned lighthouse and the majestic landscape of Peggy’s Cove. At this time of day, we have the area almost all to ourselves to explore with your local guide who is a local professional photographer. They will share photo insights tailored to your needs, and reveal our favourite vantage points to help you improve your travel photography. To experience more of the local history, we showcase some of the rich stories of the area through archival images, maps and film clips courtesy of the NS Archives.
